meta.note: Tokens the app needs that the claude.ai design system (tokens.json, copied verbatim) does not define. Same format as tokens.json (groups of {name, value, usage}); values may alias tokens.json. When the design system gains one of these, delete it here: the generator fails on duplicates.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.land
tokens.usage: Vector basemap land and background; also the rim of POI icons and the halo of map text drawn by the app.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.urban
tokens.usage: Built-up landcover at low zooms, one step off the land.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.water
tokens.usage: Seas, lakes and rivers.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.park
tokens.usage: Parks, gardens and the zoo.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.wood
tokens.usage: Woods and forest, a step deeper than parks.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.grass
tokens.usage: Grass, scrub and farmland.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.sand
tokens.usage: Sand, beaches and bare ground.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.building
tokens.usage: Building footprints. The basemap draws them at 50 % opacity (overlapping parts read darker), so this sits two steps off the land.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.pedestrian
tokens.usage: Pedestrian squares and plazas, lighter than the land.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.hospital
tokens.usage: Hospital grounds.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.school
tokens.usage: School and university grounds.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.industrial
tokens.usage: Industrial, military and airport grounds.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.road

tokens.name: color.map.vector.road-casing
tokens.usage: Casing of minor and service streets.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.major
tokens.usage: Main roads and their links: muted peach, never yellow (yellow is the answer street).

tokens.name: color.map.vector.major-casing
tokens.usage: Casing of main roads.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.highway
tokens.usage: Motorways and trunk roads, a step stronger than main roads.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.highway-casing
tokens.usage: Casing of motorways and trunk roads.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.path
tokens.usage: Footways, paths and steps (dashed).

tokens.name: color.map.vector.railway
tokens.usage: Railway lines.

tokens.name: color.map.vector.boundary
tokens.usage: Administrative boundaries.

tokens.name: color.map.poi.shop
tokens.usage: Supermarket, mall and market icon discs.

tokens.name: color.map.poi.culture
tokens.usage: Museum, theatre, cinema, gallery, monument and attraction icon discs.

tokens.name: color.map.poi.worship
tokens.usage: Place of worship icon discs.

tokens.name: color.map.poi.nature
tokens.usage: Park, garden, zoo and peak icon discs.

tokens.name: color.map.poi.transit

tokens.name: color.map.poi.civic

tokens.name: color.map.poi.health

tokens.name: color.map.poi.glyph
tokens.usage: The symbol on a POI icon disc.

color.note: Colours the design system has no token for: primitives its component CSS uses directly (league ladder, avatars, badge fields, illustration fills), and the vector basemap palette (color.map.vector.*, color.map.poi.*), which replaces the CARTO-based color.map.basemap.* in the app.

tokens.name: motion.shimmer
tokens.usage: One sweep of the skeleton shimmer (.pd-skel::after in the design system's bundle.css), repeating while content loads.

duration.note: Durations the design system uses in its component CSS but has no token for.

tokens.name: opacity.shimmer
tokens.usage: The skeleton shimmer's peak over color.surface.sunken (.pd-skel::after).

opacity.note: Opacities the design system uses in its component CSS but has no token for.
